audit.note: Passed certifies the named provenance/internal-consistency/count scopes, not the success of an expected between-policy equality.

fixed_probe_comparison.exact_rule: Original whole training trace records compared exactly, without numerical tolerances; failed equality remains failed.
fixed_probe_comparison.scope: Between-policy empirical comparison, separate from source, per-branch consistency, and count/rate audit certification. Empty histories prove no endpoint equivalence.
fixed_probe_comparison.causal_attribution: Differences are observed; their cause is not established. Equal training actions do not imply equal frozen-fork actions or counters.

fixed.scope: actual post-update matrix; descriptive only, no spectral projection or sensitivity reset

fixed_probe.scope: actual post-update matrix; descriptive only, no spectral projection or sensitivity reset

first_difference.scope: Full values remain in the original SHA-bound evaluation input; no approximate comparison.
Full values remain in the original SHA-bound evaluation input; no approximate comparison.

reporting_revision.change: Preserve the original strict equality outcome as a scientific finding instead of aborting provenance/count reporting; no runtime edits or tolerance relaxation.

public_learning_contract.action_policy: Eleven-way model argmax, without teacher-forced actions
public_learning_contract.teacher: Source-pinned causal midpoint oracle on each actual pre-action world state; supervision is not sparse reward-only learning
public_learning_contract.objective: Weighted cross entropy; equally combined live and auxiliary loss gradients, one Adam step
public_learning_contract.continuity: Course/withdrawal/return alter future NEW draws only; inherited contracts, receipts, h, optimizer and history persist

independent_sensitivity.scope: Only two fixed-direction projection evidence; structural/provenance audit status does not certify full sensitivities or all gradients.

definitions.derivative: One common additive parameter offset over the actual recorded trajectory; no derivative through optimizer, structure decisions, argmax actions or world.
definitions.auxiliary: Equal-weight auxiliary objective; detached one-block warmup and only one 128-tick differentiable suffix in formal runs.
definitions.statistics: One declared training seed is one repetition. Means/sample SD only for all three successful seeds with defined rates at the same budget.
definitions.geometry: Edges are unordered pairs. ||W-W.T||F is twice the skew-part Frobenius norm. All potential coordinates consume optimizer/credit budget.
definitions.compute: Dense N*N field MACs; two fields per Heun substep. Sparse support does not imply sparse compute savings.
definitions.evaluation: Training primals/actions independently reconstructed. Frozen evaluation forks retain actual model/source bindings and audited count/rate accounting; their full behavioral trajectories are not rerun here.
definitions.jvp: Optional separately bound independent two-direction projection calibration; neither self-hashes nor these projections prove all full-S entries or all gradients.

cache_provenance.scope: Locally produced JSON branch audit results; exact producer and all recorded raw input bytes revalidated; parent checks rerun.
